hypothesis: An EMA-teacher H2 forward representation can stabilize actor/critic decisions while a straight-through estimator routes those task gradients into online student H2 without updating the teacher.
controlled_delta: Relative to the killed critic-dominant run, only actor/critic representation routing changes; architecture, objective coefficients, JEPA targets, temperatures, EMA decays, task, seed, gamma, and curriculum remain fixed.

representation_routing.actor_critic_backward_representation: online student H2 via straight-through estimator
representation_routing.rollout_representation: JEPA EMA-teacher H2 decoded by online actor/critic heads

ste_equation: H_route = H_student + stopgrad(H_teacher - H_student); forward(H_route)=H_teacher, dH_route/dH_student=I, dH_route/dH_teacher=0

architecture.routing: X queries [X,H1_prev]; H1_prev queries [H1_prev,Z]; H2_prev queries [H2_prev,H1]

required_canary_evidence: actor/critic forward outputs equal direct teacher-H2 decoding
online actor and critic heads receive nonzero gradients
JEPA teacher gradient maximum is exactly zero
finite tensors and zero skipped updates
teacher/student H2 MSE and cosine telemetry are present
falsification: Reject if gradient routing violates the contract, teacher/student drift becomes uncontrolled, behavior remains a deterministic fixed-time policy, correctness fails to exceed the older 64-67% range, or theta never advances.
